guard.note: the handler: copies the record's list into a new ArrayList; rebuilds structurify$structures only when it is null or structurify$originalStructures differs from the copy; returns structurify$structures
sets the id and resets structurify$structures and structurify$originalStructures to null (a config load): the reset the switch sees through the answer field
the mixin's declared methods: the answer field is written only by the handler and structurify$setStructureSetId
the record accessor Structurify wraps: returns the final structures field
a record of (structures, placement): nothing replaces the structures list after construction

structurify_set_entries_reuse.conversion: MixinSquared @Inject(HEAD, cancellable) into Structurify's structurify$getStructures handler returns its last answer while the record's list is the same immutable object and Structurify's answer field (read through an @Accessor, resolved after Structurify's mixin added the field) is unchanged; MixinExtras @ModifyReturnValue at the handler's RETURN keeps that answer with the record list
